input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Explore: pre-commit-config-check, a pre-commit config validator matched to pre-commit itself

errors.what: First draft of the unknown-hook-key rule called prek keys (priority, env) in Airflow, Ruff and tox typos
errors.fix: Installed prek 0.5.11, probed each key with prek validate-config, added a prek-key info rule

errors.what: Two test expectations of mine were wrong (line number; schema-order first error); a third assumed pre-commit logs the mutable-rev warning before a hooks error
errors.fix: Checked each against real pre-commit output, corrected the tests; checker was right

errors.what: A seeded mutant of the YAML float regex survived the first test suite
errors.fix: Added 08 and 1e+5 (strings in PyYAML) to the typing test; mutant now caught

integrity_issues.what: While drafting differential/README.md I wrote a breakdown of mutant outcomes (2,733 accepted, 27 YAML errors) without having computed it
integrity_issues.fix: Caught before commit; recomputed with pre-commit's loader (2,760 accepted; 2,314 rejected, 223 as YAML errors; 101 crashes) and replaced it

doc_friction.issue: quality_mutate.py runs the test command inside the venture dir; the playbook example implies a repo-root path, and the first three tries failed with 'baseline failed' (the tool's hint explained it)
A backgrounded subshell `(python3 -m http.server &)` in a Bash call was refused by the removal safety check although nothing was deleted; use run_in_background instead

notes: Explore idea: validate .pre-commit-config.yaml exactly as pre-commit 4.7.0 does, in the browser, by re-expressing clientlib.py/cfgv in schema order and carrying a PyYAML-typed YAML reader and a CPython 3.11 regex syntax checker; then list beyond-pre-commit findings (ignored hook keys, duplicate keys, glued args, prek keys). Differential results 2026-11-22: config verdict, first-error chain and warnings agree with pre-commit's loader on 5,244/5,244 files (69 public configs + 5,175 single-edit mutants); YAML 114/114 identical to PyYAML 6.0.4; regex verdicts 199,999/200,000 vs CPython 3.11.18. In the 69 public configs: 328 of 448 revs are tags not SHAs; 3 projects use prek-only keys. Local checks: run_venture_tests (31 + 23 tests), quality_mutate 3/3 caught, Chromium render at 390px, check_third_party, register-tool, venture-preflight.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: estimate: a developer writing a PyYAML-compatible reader, a CPython regex validator and pre-commit schema port with differential harnesses, page and CLI

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
